data: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra spirit damage with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist.
Cooldown is 2x longer for Light Melee hits.
Grants Lifesteal, Fire Rate, and Ammo. This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.
Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount.
This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes.
Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.
Apply a Stun after 2s. Stun duration is increased against airborne targets.
Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun.
Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage, Move speed reduction and Disarm.
Your next Melee attack heals you.
This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes.
Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.
Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed.
Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.
Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.
Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Melee Damage.
Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
Does not affect target's stamina usage.
When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate.
Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing spirit damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist.
When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack.
Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.
Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units.
Provides move speed and fire rate to you and nearby allies. Minions get double value.
Reduces the effect of enemy Move Speed penalties.
Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit an enemy hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.
Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power.
Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health.
Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.
Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist.
Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm.
Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.
Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.
Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet and Spirit Resist and applies Healing Reduction.
Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time.
Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.
Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target. This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.
Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.
Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing spirit damage over time. The turret expires after a limited lifetime.
Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.
+25% Turret Fire Rate and +12s Turret Lifetime
Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location.
McGinnis is slowed and is still able to use stamina.
Applies 24% movement and dash slow for 1s
+2m Radius and +15.0 Damage per Rocket with increased spirit scaling
Create a time warping wall that stops time for all enemy projectiles and bullets that touch it and increases the speed and damage of friendly bullets.
Enemies that touch the wall will be briefly slowed and silenced .
Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing spirit damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with weapon damage. Move speed is increased while charging.
While in the air and charging, to timeslow your movement.
+2s Charge Hold Duration and +55% Damage Scaling
Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that heals allies and applies spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.
-10 Cooldown and debuff now freezes Stamina Regen
+2m Radius. Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased.
Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold Ability 1 or to hold the shot.
Improved damage scaling and -3s Charge Delay
Launches you high in the air, allowing you to glide slowly. While airborne, you gain Weapon Damage and multishot on your weapon.
Press Jump / mantle to cancel the glide.
While airborne, +3 Weapon Damage and weapon damage applies 24% movement slow for 1.5s
While airborne, +30% Bullet Lifesteal, +30% Spirit Lifesteal and +30% Bullet Evasion
Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done. Heal is stronger against enemy heroes.
Adds a debuff to enemies that lets Mo & Krill deal +15% Damage to them. Stacks and lasts 16s.
Spray sand that disarms enemies in front of you and deals damage.
Slow targets by -24% and reduces dash distances by -26%
Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.
+0.7s Duration and +40.0 Damage Per Second and increased scaling
Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.
Channel to increase damage over 1.4 seconds, then release a fully-charged sword strike.
Press Ability 1 or to trigger the strike early, dealing partial damage.
+150.0 Damage and Increases Spirit Power scaling
Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate. If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal.
On Hero Hit : +6% Max Health Heal

Become infused with Yamato's shadow soul. After an initial invincible transformation your abilities are refreshed and are 60% faster. You gain immunity to negative status effects and have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.
When you get a hero kill, you heal and the duration is extended.
Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.
Struck enemies are knocked up and slowed by 40% for 3s
Damage Per Meter +120% and improved scaling

Focus on enemies to connect whips to them. After channeling, connected enemies are lifted and stunned then slammed into the ground. Your victims and any enemies in the landing zone will be damaged and slowed.
Press to throw connected enemies early. Enemies that are not in line of sight or go out of range during the latch time will not be grabbed.
